description: Risk register derived from failure modes with H or M action priority.
data_classification: SIMULATED ENTERPRISE ARTEFACT - not OEM, customer or proprietary data

records.title: Risk arising from: Cell temperature exceeds qualified operating window during sustained high load
records.risk_statement: Power derate, reduced performance, accelerated degradation arising from thermal path capacity insufficient at high ambient combined with high discharge rate.

records.title: Risk arising from: Capacity fade rate higher than predicted
records.risk_statement: State of health falls below warranty commitment before end of warranty period arising from sustained operation at elevated cell temperature accelerates degradation.

records.title: Risk arising from: Loss of enclosure sealing integrity
records.risk_statement: Moisture ingress, isolation resistance degradation, potential HV fault arising from seal compression set after thermal cycling.

records.title: Risk arising from: Vent blocked or fails to equalise
records.risk_statement: Pressure differential stresses enclosure seals, potential seal failure arising from vent membrane contamination during assembly.

records.title: Risk arising from: Cooling plate heat rejection below specification
records.risk_statement: Cell temperature rises faster than predicted, earlier thermal derate arising from reduced braze joint coverage lowers effective conduction area.

records.title: Risk arising from: Coolant leak into the pack enclosure
records.risk_statement: Isolation loss, potential HV fault, vehicle immobilisation arising from through-wall porosity in braze joint.

records.title: Risk arising from: Protection threshold not triggered when cell temperature exceeds limit
records.risk_statement: Cell damage, potential thermal runaway initiation arising from temperature sensor placement not representative of hottest cell.

records.title: Risk arising from: State of health estimate diverges from measured capacity
records.risk_statement: Incorrect warranty and residual value assessment, incorrect derate strategy arising from ageing model does not represent the revised cell chemistry ageing behaviour.

records.title: Risk arising from: Power limit reported inconsistent with actual cell capability
records.risk_statement: Either performance loss or cell overstress arising from limit map not updated for revised internal resistance characteristic.

records.title: Risk arising from: Chiller capacity insufficient at high ambient with concurrent cabin demand
records.risk_statement: Battery temperature rises, thermal derate engages, performance and charge rate reduced arising from refrigerant circuit capacity shared between cabin and battery loads.

records.title: Risk arising from: Charge inlet contact overheats
records.risk_statement: Contact degradation, potential thermal damage to inlet and cable arising from elevated contact resistance from wear or contamination combined with high current.

records.title: Risk arising from: DC charge contactor fails to open
records.risk_statement: HV present at inlet when not charging, shock hazard arising from contact welding after repeated high current interruption.

records.title: Risk arising from: Unintended propulsion torque produced
records.risk_statement: Unexpected vehicle motion, potential collision arising from latent fault in torque path not detected by monitoring.

records.title: Risk arising from: Power module junction temperature exceeds limit
records.risk_statement: Derate, and in severe cases module damage arising from cooling path degradation or elevated coolant inlet temperature.

records.title: Risk arising from: Stopping distance exceeds required performance
records.risk_statement: Non-compliance with braking approval requirements arising from friction coefficient of the compound lower than assumed at required conditions.

records.title: Risk arising from: Excessive brake fade during repeated high energy stops
records.risk_statement: Reduced deceleration capability, potential non-compliance arising from compound thermal stability lower than the previous formulation.

records.title: Risk arising from: Brake squeal at low speed
records.risk_statement: Customer perceived quality concern, warranty claims arising from compound damping characteristics differ from previous formulation.

records.title: Risk arising from: Restricted substance content above permitted level
records.risk_statement: Market access restriction, potential regulatory non-compliance arising from raw material composition variation at the supplier.

records.title: Risk arising from: Control arm structural crack during durability
records.risk_statement: Loss of wheel location, loss of vehicle control arising from load path stress concentration higher than analysis predicted.

records.title: Risk arising from: Bushing radial stiffness outside specified tolerance band
records.risk_statement: Altered handling and ride characteristics, increased road noise arising from rubber compound cure variation at the transferred plant.

records.title: Risk arising from: Bushing displacement within the arm bore under load
records.risk_statement: Progressive change in geometry, noise, and eventual loss of location arising from press-fit interference below specification.

records.title: Risk arising from: Loss of steering assist without safe state
records.risk_statement: Substantially increased steering effort, potential loss of control arising from undetected fault in the steering control processing element.

records.title: Risk arising from: Processing element diagnostic coverage below allocated requirement
records.risk_statement: Safety requirement not met at the allocated integrity level arising from successor device has different internal safety mechanism set.

records.title: Risk arising from: Radiated emissions exceed limit in a specific frequency band
records.risk_statement: Approval failure, launch delay arising from reduced hv harness shield effectiveness after routing change.

records.title: Risk arising from: Shield termination impedance higher than specified
records.risk_statement: Increased radiated emissions, reduced immunity margin arising from ground strap contact resistance increased by coating or corrosion.

records.title: Risk arising from: HV harness routed closer than minimum separation to antenna circuits
records.risk_statement: Coupling into receiver circuits, degraded reception, emissions margin loss arising from packaging constraint forced routing deviation.

records.title: Risk arising from: Unauthorised message injection accepted by a controller
records.risk_statement: Loss of vehicle function integrity, safety and regulatory exposure arising from insufficient message authentication on a legacy interface.

records.title: Risk arising from: HVAC energy consumption exceeds the allocated budget
records.risk_statement: Certified range shortfall arising from larger compressor consumes more energy at part load.

records.title: Risk arising from: Rolling resistance above the allocated value
records.risk_statement: Certified range shortfall arising from larger diameter lower profile tyre has higher rolling resistance.

records.title: Risk arising from: Tyre rolling sound emission above the approval limit
records.risk_statement: Approval failure for the affected variant arising from wider tread pattern increases rolling sound emission.

records.title: Risk arising from: Tyre load capability below requirement at maximum axle load
records.risk_statement: Safety exposure and approval non-compliance arising from load index selection not reassessed after mass increase.

records.title: Risk arising from: Supply voltage falls below the specified band under peak demand
records.risk_statement: Reset or malfunction of safety relevant controllers arising from increased harness voltage drop after component relocation.

records.title: Risk arising from: Conversion efficiency below requirement after ageing
records.risk_statement: Emissions non-compliance in service arising from reduced precious metal loading lowers ageing margin.

records.title: Risk arising from: Light-off time longer than required
records.risk_statement: Cold start emissions exceed the applicable limit arising from lower loading increases the temperature required for light-off.

records.title: Risk arising from: Catalyst monitor cannot distinguish a degraded catalyst
records.risk_statement: OBD requirement not met arising from monitor threshold not recalibrated for the revised formulation.

records.title: Risk arising from: Insufficient braze joint coverage
records.risk_statement: Reduced heat rejection capability of the finished plate arising from furnace atmosphere dew point outside the qualified window.

records.title: Risk arising from: Through-wall porosity in the braze joint
records.risk_statement: Coolant leak into the pack, isolation loss arising from flux residue or contamination at the joint interface.

records.title: Risk arising from: Leak test fails to detect a leak within specification
records.risk_statement: Leaking plate escapes to the next process arising from measurement system capability insufficient at the specified leak rate.

records.title: Risk arising from: Insufficient thermal interface material coverage
records.risk_statement: Local hot spots and increased cell temperature gradient arising from dispense path or volume outside specification.

records.title: Risk arising from: Seal not correctly seated in the groove
records.risk_statement: Ingress path into the pack, isolation degradation in service arising from seal handling damage or incorrect placement.

records.title: Risk arising from: Capacity measurement not representative
records.risk_statement: Under-capacity packs escape to the vehicle arising from measurement conditions differ from the specification reference.

records.title: Risk arising from: Press-fit interference below specification
records.risk_statement: Bushing displacement in service, geometry change and noise arising from bore diameter at the upper tolerance combined with bushing at the lower tolerance.

records.title: Risk arising from: Cure state outside the qualified window
records.risk_statement: Radial stiffness outside the specified tolerance band arising from cure time or temperature deviation at the transferred plant.

records.title: Risk arising from: Harness routed outside the defined path
records.risk_statement: Reduced separation from sensitive circuits, EMC margin loss arising from routing clips omitted or positioned incorrectly.

records.title: Risk arising from: Shield termination contact resistance above limit
records.risk_statement: EMC performance degradation arising from coating not removed at the termination point.

records.title: Risk arising from: Density outside the specified range
records.risk_statement: Friction coefficient and wear rate outside specification arising from preform mass or press pressure deviation.

records.title: Risk arising from: Restricted substance content above permitted level
records.risk_statement: Market access restriction arising from incoming raw material batch variation.

records.title: Risk arising from: Thermal interface voids exceed limit
records.risk_statement: Elevated junction temperature and earlier derate arising from insufficient clamping force or interface material spread.
